name: amfx-usdcad-oil
description: amFX reproduction (12JUN23 p2): USDCAD vs NYMEX WTI Crude Oil overlay. Oil plotted as negative values to simulate inverted axis (oil down = USDCAD up visual correlation). Shows historically tight correlation and May 2023 decoupling. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: USDCAD vs NYMEX WTI Crude Oil (Inverted)
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 2 chart from amFX 12JUN23 newsletter.
# USDCAD vs crude oil with oil on inverted axis.
# Oil price is negated to simulate inverted right axis:
# when oil falls (goes more negative), line moves up like USDCAD.
# Shows correlation breakdown in May 2023.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
usdcad = src.c

# WTI Crude Oil price from FRED (daily)
oil_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DCOILWTICO')()
oil_raw = ffill(oil_src.result)

# Negate oil to simulate inverted axis
oil_inverted = 0 - oil_raw

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: USDCAD vs Oil (Inverted) Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='USDCAD vs WTI Crude (Inverted): Is the Correlation Breaking Down?',
    category='FX vs Commodities',
    y_axis_label='USDCAD / Oil (inverted)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USDCAD', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Crude (inverted)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, usdcad, oil_inverted)
